name: qa-platform-local-qa
description: Analyze project source and test localhost applications with QA Platform.

commands.title: QA Platform: Run Full Local Audit
QA Platform: Run Local Load Test (up to 250 users)

qaPlatform.localhostUrl.description: Approved localhost URL used by the Test Localhost command.

qaPlatform.maxFiles.description: Maximum number of source files scanned in one workspace analysis.

qaPlatform.auditMaxPages.description: Maximum pages visited by the local browser audit.

qaPlatform.auditScreenshots.description: Capture page screenshots as audit evidence.

qaPlatform.importantPages.description: Additional localhost paths to audit even when not linked from the start page.

qaPlatform.storageState.description: Optional Playwright storage-state JSON path relative to the workspace for authenticated audits.

qaPlatform.loadTestUsers.description: Default virtual users for the opt-in local load test.

qaPlatform.loadTestRampUpSeconds.description: Time used to ramp virtual users up gradually.

qaPlatform.loadTestPaths.description: Local paths exercised by each virtual user.

qaPlatform.loadTestMaxErrorRate.description: Warning threshold for HTTP/network errors as a percentage.

qaPlatform.loadTestMaxP95Ms.description: Warning threshold for p95 response time.

scripts.check: node --check extension.js && node --check browser-audit.cjs && node --check load-tester.cjs
